Strict-Transport-Security.notes: HSTS is properly configured with a 2-year duration, includeSubDomains flag, and preload readiness.

X-Frame-Options.notes: Clickjacking defense is enabled by completely prohibiting framing.

X-Content-Type-Options.notes: MIME sniffing prevention is properly enforced.

Referrer-Policy.notes: Referrer leakage is restricted across origins.

Permissions-Policy.notes: Sensitive browser APIs (camera, mic, geolocation, payment) are restricted.

Content-Security-Policy.notes: Content-Security-Policy header is absent. Without CSP, the application lacks defense-in-depth against client-side script injection and malicious inline script execution.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.notes: Wildcard CORS origin is returned on the root HTML response. While standard for static public sites without credentials, defining specific permitted origins or avoiding CORS on document roots is recommended.

Server.notes: Server header discloses the edge infrastructure software name (Vercel).

X-XSS-Protection.notes: Legacy header present. Modern browsers prioritize CSP over X-XSS-Protection.
